agent_explanation: Energy jumps from ~1790 J to 23888 J at the first collision (step 6->7) between a heavy static body (m=16.9) and a light fast body (m=1, vx=-47.8). The heavy body gains speed 0.84->51.2 m/s, larger than the impactor, while the light body keeps ~45 m/s. This violates momentum conservation and creates energy; impulse calculation likely swaps masses or scales by 1/m incorrectly, amplified at high relative speed and high mass ratio.
